title: Supreme of Chicken with Mushroom Velouté & Truffle Mash
description: Supreme of Chicken with Mushroom Velouté & Truffle Mash is a refined Continental main course featuring pan-seared chicken supreme served with a silky mushroom velouté, creamy truffle mashed potatoes, and glazed seasonal vegetables. This elegant dish is perfect for fine dining and special occasions.

ingredients.title: For the Chicken Supreme
items: Chicken supremes (breast with first wing bone attached, skin on) – 2
Freshly ground white pepper – to taste
Clarified butter or neutral oil – 1 tbsp

ingredients.title: For the Mushroom Velouté
items: Chicken stock (preferably homemade, double strength) – 250 ml

ingredients.title: For Truffle Mashed Potatoes
items: Truffle oil or finely chopped black truffle – 1 tsp

ingredients.title: For Garnish
items: Truffle oil or herb oil – for drizzling

instruction.title: Step 1 – Prepare the Chicken Supreme
steps: Trim the chicken supreme neatly, leaving skin intact.
Season lightly with salt and pepper.
Heat clarified butter in a sauté pan over medium heat.
Place the chicken skin-side down; sear gently until golden brown (about 4–5 minutes).
Turn over, add a knob of butter and thyme; baste until cooked through (internal temp 74°C / 165°F).
Rest for 5 minutes before slicing.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Make the Mushroom Velouté
steps: In a saucepan, melt butter and sauté shallots and mushrooms until tender and lightly browned.
Stir in flour and cook for 1 minute to make a roux.
Gradually whisk in hot chicken stock until smooth.
Simmer gently for 8–10 minutes.
Strain through a fine sieve, pressing to extract flavor.
Add cream, white wine, and a touch of lemon juice; reduce to coating consistency.
Adjust seasoning and keep warm.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Prepare Truffle Mash
steps: Boil potatoes in salted water until tender.
Drain and mash while hot.
Stir in butter and warm cream until smooth and silky.
Add truffle oil (or minced truffle) and season to taste.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Glaze the Vegetables
steps: Lightly blanch baby vegetables (carrot, beans, zucchini) until just tender.
Toss in butter, salt, and a drop of stock until shiny.

instruction.title: Step 5 – Plate Like a Pro
steps: Spoon a quenelle of truffle mash at one side of the plate.
Slice the rested chicken diagonally and fan beside the mash.
Nap (coat) with mushroom velouté, letting it cascade gently.
Arrange baby vegetables artfully and finish with micro herbs and a fine drizzle of truffle or herb oil.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve hot with truffle mashed potatoes and glazed seasonal vegetables.
Pair with Chardonnay (lightly oaked) or Viognier.
Finish with a light drizzle of truffle oil before serving.

chefTips: Rest the chicken for 5 minutes before slicing to retain its juices.
Strain the mushroom velouté for an extra smooth, restaurant-quality finish.
Use warm cream when preparing mashed potatoes for a silky texture.
For a Michelin-style touch, brush the plate edge with a streak of mushroom purée or a drop of parsley oil before service.
